text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
The final stop of the Triple Tiara, the<n>Shuka Sho, is
here. Mejiro Dober is<n>so focused, even the cheers
of the<n>crowd don't faze her.

text_block_list.name: Monólogo
text_block_list.text:
Just before the race, Mejiro Dober<n>passionately
declares that she will<n>show everyone just how
much<n>she's improved in the Triple Tiara!
